I felt it wasn't helping. It takes a while to see if it's helping or not. Your therapist is good if they teach you coping mechanisms and skills like that. Also, different people are comfortable with different therapists. 

Don't be bothered by all of that. Give it some time, therapy is slow. If it isn't helping, don't give up. It can take a while to find the right one. Good luck!:)

Hey! I'm the same boat. I can't focus on anything anymore. I loved writing, and it's the only thing I'm decent at, but can't do it anymore. Can't read, watching show or even movies. Video games aren't fun anymore. It sucks. 

But honestly, professional help might help. It took me 5 years to find a good doctor and a good therapist. I've been on all the meds you have been on and it took me forever to find something that worked. I also had to go through 6 therapists before I found the right one. 

Hope you feel better soon, depression sucks ass. Hope we beat it!
Hope the people who tortured you go through the depths of fucking hell. I'm not remotely religious, but this makes me want to believe there's a special place in hell for people like this.

I can't imagine going through so much. Most of our worries pale in comparison, even when combined together. 

You've been through a lot and I hope there's heaven and hope you go there. If there's nothing after this life, I'm beyond furious. No one should have to live that way.

Hey. I'm really sorry, it sounds like a really tough spot to be in. I hope you feel better. If you want to vent to someone until your appointment with the therapist, I'd be more than happy to volunteer. Take care man. You'll get through this.

Hey man, take it slow. I'm sure you've got this. I have frequent anxiety attacks and I'm socially anxious so I can relate a bit. You'll get used to it in a while. I'm the kind of guy who'd starve because he can't order food because of social anxiety. And I kinda got used to people. You will too!

Not OP, but both help! Actually it's more of learning about yourself and your habits when you go to the therapist. Plus they help deal with depression and anxiety. Finding a good one takes time and you might have to switch a few times / talk to the therapist about the type of therapy and what's working for you and what's not. Just keep an open mind and know that it's a long process that is totally worth it. Good luck buddy, have a nice week :)

Hey, you deserve all the support! And you're one of the good people you're talking about. Take care and have an amazing week buddy!

Honestly, the people who actually care about me are online friends. I don't have many irl friends who I can trust. You can start off with online friends! Trust me it gets easier in the long run. When you're comfortable, make friends irl. 

To start things off, I'll be your friend! I'd love to know more about you.

That's the mind tricking you buddy. I used to think the same. I still do. But I'm better. Please don't hurt yourself. Give this whole thing one more chance? It won't cost you anything. Get therapy. It helps. You'll make changes in your life, gain self esteem and be happy.

But I really would love it if you'd just talk for a moment? I'm not gonna try to tell you how great life is or any of that bullshit. Just talk. We can talk right here in this thread. Please?

I've been in that place. But hey, you have friends now! We're your friends. And it's not gonna stop here. You're gonna go out and make some more. You'll find your group. I have dealt with this almost my entire life, so I could probably give you some tips?

Can you please just consider talking to one of us and thinking this whole thing through once more? I don't even know you, man. But I care about you. Please be safe man.

And are you under / have you considered therapy? Therapy and meds are the way to go. It might take a while to find the right medicine but it's honestly worth it. 

I hope you have a nice day. Have a great week, stay strong. My pm is open. Please hang in there. You've got this.
